messages:
mira: Quick sync — recruitment + launch SLAs for the next Design Partner cohort. Two asks: 1) confirm target mix (compliance-heavy vs high-traffic apps), 2) agree on feedback cadence + bug SLA for beta. Thoughts?

alex: IMO we should aim for a 60/40 split favoring high-traffic product teams. gives better perf/cost signal. compliance customers can be 2-3 anchor partners.

sam: +1 to that mix. also we should treat compliance partners as longer-term pilots (separate onboarding timeline).

mira: Good. For feedback cadence I'm proposing: weekly async status + 2 live check-ins over the 8-week pilot (kickoff + midpoint). Is that lightweight enough for eng?

alex: Weekly async is fine, but we need clear signal templates. propose short form: 5 prompts, 3 perf metrics (p99 latency, tokens/sec, fail rate), qualitative grade for hallucinations.

jordan: Can we add a quick repro artifact requirement for any bug reports? One-liner + request id + minimal prompt. saves cycles.

mira: Agreed. Let's standardize the template. I'll draft and post to the DP channel.

sam: SLA for critical issues — what counts as critical? We should align on severity levels: P0 (service down / evicting traffic), P1 (data/response correctness regressions), P2 (UX annoyances). P0 => 2h ack, P1 => 24h ack + 72h remediation plan, P2 => next-sprint triage.
alex: Those windows are reasonable. For hosted vs dedicated customers we might have different remediation commitments — flagging to legal/sales.

mira: Noted. For launch criteria I'm proposing gating on three things: 1) stability (p99 < SLO baseline across cohort), 2) quality (no systemic drop vs baseline evals), 3) onboarding completion for 80% of partners (onboarding defined as running 1k interactive tokens).
jordan: Can we make the 1k token threshold configurable per partner? Some compliance pilots will have low volume but high-risk needs.
mira: Yes — we'll add an exception path. exceptions require engineering sign-off (alex).

ops-bot: Reminder: please attach the cohort roster to the recruitment thread by EOD Friday.

sam: Action items: mira to share template + cohort roster by Friday. alex to review exception sign-offs within 24h of request. jordan to add repro artifact checklist to bug triage doc. I'll own SLA wording and push to the handbook.

mira: Thanks — will post drafts here. If no objections by Friday we'll lock recruitment messaging and send invites next week. :thumbsup:

alex: one more ask — can we batch feedback sampling? instead of asking all partners weekly, rotate deep-sample (2 partners/week) + shallow signal from the rest. reduces burden on partners and gives focused eval sets.
sam: love that. add it to the template and we'll include a rotating schedule column in the roster.
mira: Perfect. Closing loop: draft + roster up Friday, rollout invites Mon/Tue.

jordan: :rocket:

ops-bot: Thread archived to product/DP-recruitment on close.
